Description: Adds an estimated CO2e and energy dashboard to the Umbraco.AI Analytics section. It reads the chat usage Umbraco.AI already records and estimates the footprint using the EcoLogits method, shown as a middle estimate with a low-to-high range. This is an unofficial community package, not made or supported by Umbraco HQ, and the figures are estimates.
